files.reason: The wave 4 merge bindings 1-8 (the w4a, w4b and w4c briefs): one class per pair held by one lane and taken by another, each green on the merged modules and red under one in-memory mutant of the pair's value. Binding 5 runs both login readers over the union of both lanes' planted fixtures and the four cases of glitch-f3's ruling; binding 8 binds lock key paths only (load wiring is CP2's first sequential lane). Round 3 had no box.
